EasyMDE 2.21.0
Source: https://github.com/Ionaru/easy-markdown-editor
License: MIT. See LICENSE.

The distributed EasyMDE browser bundle includes CodeMirror and Marked components.
Both projects use MIT licenses; their source and license notices are available at:
- CodeMirror: https://github.com/codemirror/codemirror5
- Marked: https://github.com/markedjs/marked

EasyMDE's optional spell checker is disabled by this application. Editor assets are
served locally; no editor assets or fonts are fetched from a third-party CDN.
